name: 07-not-acceptable
description: The RAML only declares application/json responses, so Accept: application/xml raises NotAcceptableException, mapped to 406 with a JSON message.

source.reference: testing-apikit-with-munit/src/main/app/api.xml (apikit:mapping statusCode=406 NotAcceptableException -> payload { "message": "Not acceptable" }); testing-apikit-with-munit/src/main/api/api.raml (get responses 200 body application/json only)
